{{transliteration|ar|Lughat il-Ishārah il-Qasim}} |altname=KQSL |states=Israel |region=[[Kafr Qasem]] |speakers=50 |date=2020 |ref=e25 |familycolor=sign |family=[[village sign language|village sign]] |iso3=sqx |glotto=kafr1234 |glottorefname=Kafr Qasem Sign Language }} '''Kafr Qasem Sign Language''' ({{native name|ar|لغة الإشارة الكفر قاسم|italics=off}} {{transliteration|ar|Lughat il-Ishārah il-Kafr Qasim}}) is a [[village sign language]] in Israel.Kastner, Itamar, Irit Meir, Wendy Sandler, and Svetlana Dachkovsky. 2014. The emergence of embedded structure: insights from Kafr Qasem Sign Language. ''Frontiers in Psychology'' Vol 5, article 525. [http://journal.frontiersin.org/article/10.3389/fpsyg.2014.00525/full Web access] The language is in the process of being documented, mainly at the [[University of Haifa]]. [[Kafr Qasem]] is characterized by a relatively high percentage of people with a [[hearing impairment]], and apparently, their sign language developed spontaneously over the years, even if it was influenced by [[Israeli Sign Language]] and local sign languages from the region.{{Cite web |date=16 January 2013 |title=המילון המקוונן לשפת סימנים כפר קאסם – Sign Language Research Lab |url=https://signlab.haifa.ac.il/2013/10/15/kqsl-2/ |access-date=2024-01-26 |language=en-US}} The beginning of the [[deaf community]] in Kafr Qasem began at the beginning of the 20th century, when a villager married a deaf woman from [[Mazra'a|Mazraa]]. The couple had deaf children, who in turn married and had more deaf children. In 1951, there were 1800 residents in Kafr Qasem, 12 of whom were deaf. The need to communicate with them led to the development of a sign language shared by the locals – deaf and hearing.{{Cite web |date=7 February 2017 |title=סוד השפה הנעלמת של חרשי כפר קאסם |url=https://www.ha-makom.co.il/article/noga-berger-sign-language-kfar-qasem/ |access-date=2024-01-26 |website=המקום הכי חם |language=he-IL}} ==References== {{reflist}} == External links == * [https://signlab.haifa.ac.il/2024/04/14/kafr-qasem-sign-language-dictionary/ Kafr Qasem Sign Language Dictionary] {{Languages of Israel}} {{sign language navigation}} [[Category:Village sign languages]] [[Category:Sign languages of Israel]] [[Category:Language isolates of Asia]] [[Category:Arab Israeli culture]] {{Israel-stub}} {{sign-lang-stub}}
